text: My b2 visa was due to expire on the 5th of march, and I assumed that it was automatically extended (I met all the criteria and haven’t left the country since initial entry). When we went to PIBA Be’er Sheva to enquire about a requested document (about a month after the b2 expired), they stated that my B2 hadn’t been extended automatically for some reason, and I needed to pay for the extension. Maybe I was just unlucky, but I would suggest to somehow confirm that it was indeed extended. If there aren’t any walk-ins, so perhaps you could email them.
